summary: The Utah dossiers were mostly sound on history, geography and league dates (all CURRENT FACTS dates match). The biggest error, found with a live check, was the claim that the current Jazz identity is navy and yellow: it is Mountain Purple, Midnight Black and Sky Blue with highlighter yellow retired, which affected fanbase, uniform, retail-behavior and rhythm (fixed) and the strategy risk note (for the editor). Other fixes: Jazz Note era, Big 12 alignment, Twilight series, Central 9th versus 9th and 9th, Sun Tunnels credit, Red Iguana, Beer Bar, Craft Lake City details, Sugar Space location, URLs. Remaining risk sits in small venues, named artists, Nike and athletic doors, the 2004-2022 uniform eras, and whether Utah plays the Nov 24-25 Cup nights.
